slides.title: Variant Stock
slides.body: Grey out, disable & block out-of-stock variant options on your eCommerce shop.

slides.title: Grey Out
slides.body: Unavailable sizes and colors get opacity, strikethrough and a clear Out of Stock badge.

slides.title: Real-Time
slides.body: Stock levels checked live on every variant change via a fast JSON-RPC call.

slides.title: Auto-Disable
slides.body: Inputs and variant pills are blocked so shoppers can never pick an unavailable combination.

slides.title: One-Click
slides.body: Enable or disable per website from a single checkbox in Website Settings.
